author: Jurij
text:
Somehow I kept overlooking how advanced the PAZ topic is.

There is more to PAZ's than just the space between 2 FTRs.

I thank Les_Paul and his wonderful journal for bringing the other 3 PAZ types to my attention and showing how they work

Going over the charts during the last 2 days and marking all PAZ types
made me realize that indeed it can be simple. And by the way, just to
say, they really tend to work most of the time .

Learned from this to start taking every written word (or spoken in
videos) by IF and master traders very seriously (even write it down if
it helps) and try to mark each sentence on the charts to get a feel for
it.

I think another often overlooked key topic is the "tricks played by ITs" one (see the webinar video).

When I feel stuck, going over all material again always helps.

It's like reading a book and every time from a slightly different perspective.

Don't give up, you can do it (note to myself and anyone struggling)

Yes I think you are right. That engulf already reached it's target.

And above there is another FL.

I would not trade such an engulf, firstly because on HTF we have an
engulf down, and then because all that supply FTRs stacked together.

As you said, many times the engulf reaches the next FL/FTR straight
away, that's why it is also important to look for engulfs into zones
(PAZ).

Then there is still this thing about different scales that I've yet to
figure out. Like, what happens if price engulfs an FL but reaches the
next FL on a lower scale, will price go to the next bigger scale FL or
can the LTF FL reverse price (becoming the target) etc...

So I think it is safe to trade only clear FLs and PAZs, for now

Hope this helps
